controlled_variable: stop for one second before the same authored stop control versus pass the control without stopping
fixed_controls: same OpenDRIVE signal 3891 at s=50 m
same ego blueprint and approach lane
same speed and camera policy within each pair
primary_policy: 8 m/s with requested stop hold or continuous passage

fallbacks.fallback1: 5 m/s if original stop before the analytic device station or passage is physically ambiguous
fallbacks.fallback2: elevated overview if sign face and approach-area pixels are not reviewed at encounter
fallbacks.fallback3: remain stopped before the device if original device, body or placement evidence is insufficient

required_original_evidence: generated road 389 and lane -1 readback at x=20,45,55 m
generated OpenDRIVE stop landmark 3891 readback at s=50 m
original body, velocity and lane in each of 240 frames
synchronized 240-frame forward and overview FFV1 videos
source-hashed human review of sign face, approach area, applicability and any police direction
authoritative official placement provenance beyond authored OpenDRIVE bytes
measured stop duration before the analytic device station and front-body crossing of that station
independent controlled comparison and legal review
